plants.symptom: The ledge gap is beatable but tight, so most testers need several tries. A bridge appears after ledge_bypass_deaths deaths.

evidence.telemetry: Several death (cause fall) and retry events inside zone ledge.
evidence.video: Repeated falls into the pit at the same gap.
evidence.voice: Frustration at the jump, e.g. 'is this jump even possible?'

plants.symptom: The beacon over the terrace door is the same colour as the wall behind it, so players can't see where to go.

evidence.telemetry: Supporting only: long time between zone_enter plaza and zone_enter hall.
evidence.video: The beacon is barely visible against the back wall; the player wanders the plaza.

plants.symptom: The switch on the balcony is visible, but the prompt doesn't point to it.

evidence.telemetry: Long dwell between zone_enter hall and the objective_update that follows the switch press. Not input_idle: searching players keep moving.
evidence.video: The player roams the hall and tries the gate before finding the switch.

tunable.fixed: Press the red switch on the balcony to open the gate.

plants.symptom: An enemy charges the moment the player lands from a blind drop.

evidence.telemetry: death (cause enemy) within a few seconds of zone_enter drop, often repeated.
evidence.video: The player lands and is hit before they can react.
evidence.voice: Surprise or complaints of unfairness, e.g. 'I couldn't even see it'.

plants.symptom: The EXIT sign at the fork points into a non-lethal dead end.

evidence.telemetry: Backtracking: zone_enter fork_left, zone_exit fork_left, zone_enter fork, then the right branch. No deaths.
evidence.video: The player follows the arrow, hits the dead end and turns back.

plants.symptom: A long, empty corridor with nothing to do.

evidence.telemetry: Long dwell between zone_enter corridor and zone_exit corridor (planted is 240 m, about 40 s at full speed).
evidence.video: Identical walls scroll past for a long time.
evidence.voice: Boredom, e.g. 'this goes on a while'.
